title: Book the machine, not the queue
brief: Members queue for the laser cutter while other machines sit idle, and nobody knows who booked what or whether they are certified.

target_population.role: evening steward of a community makerspace with six machines
target_population.coverage_limit: one makerspace, six machines, four evening slots; no billing or member management

core_task.summary: reserve an evening laser-cutter slot for a certified member
core_task.success_oracle: reserving the 19:00 laser-cutter slot for certified member Vale H. fills the slot with their certification badge, while an uncertified member is refused with a notice

not_applicable_states.loading: machines, slots, members, and certifications are seeded local records, so reserving updates the grid in the same frame with nothing to await

state_recipes.empty: switch the board to Sunday, which has no seeded reservations; each machine column shows its all-slots-open message
state_recipes.validation-error: attempt to book the laser cutter for uncertified member Timo J.; a certification notice refuses the reservation
state_recipes.success: reserve the 19:00 laser slot for Vale H.; the slot fills and wears the certified badge
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the machine grid's first open slot shows its focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the board at 390x844; machine columns become swipeable stacked cards

acceptance_facts: The seed defines six machines, four evening slots each, and nine members of whom five hold laser certification.
Reserving the 19:00 laser slot for Vale H. fills the slot and displays their certification badge.
Booking an uncertified member is refused with a notice naming the missing certification.

product_signature.mechanism: certification-gated slot grid that exposes idle machine time at a glance
product_signature.brief_trace: nobody knows who booked what or whether they are certified
product_signature.counterfactual: a generic room-booking calendar would fit a meeting-space brief and cannot refuse an uncertified booking
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the 19:00 laser slot filled and badged for Vale H.

anti_goals: no billing, memberships, or payment handling
no training content or certification issuing; certifications are seeded facts
no waitlists, swaps, or notification flows

content_seed.data_notes: six invented machines and nine invented members; one seeded reservation occupies the 18:00 laser slot so 19:00 is bookable and two laser slots remain open after the core task
